$comment: What the workflow guards and skills read that cannot be read from disk. tools/guards/workflow-config.mjs validates it; init-app rewrites it for a product. skillPrefix: every skill and agent is <skillPrefix>-<name>. reservedNames: names init-app rewrites, which no skill or agent may start with. plans: where plans, specs and test notes live, and whether git tracks them. ci: manual (every workflow runs only by hand) or on-push (the check workflows' triggers are uncommented). manualAlways: workflows that never carry a push or pull_request trigger, live or commented, in any mode. githubProject: the GitHub Projects number, or null to keep state in issues alone.
